# Tools

Call a tool from a script, and read, list and delete tools. Tools are known as external operations (extops) in Maitento, which is why the calls start with `ExtOp`.

**Library:** [Maitento](index.md#maitento), for apps. More in [Tools](../../../concepts/tools.md).

| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`ExtOpDelete`](#extopdelete) | Deletes a tool. |
| [`ExtOpGet`](#extopget) | Returns a tool's definition, with every version. |
| [`ExtOpInvoke`](#extopinvoke) | Calls a tool from the app, as an agent would, and returns the response. |
| [`ExtOpList`](#extoplist) | Returns the tools in a namespace. |

### ExtOpDelete

Deletes a tool.

```c
void ExtOpDelete(string name)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The tool: `name`, or `name@namespace`. |

Name the tool as `name`, or `name@namespace` for one in another namespace of your tenant; a name without `@` is looked up in this app's namespace.

It is refused while the latest version of an agent, interaction, app or code pipeline uses the tool, or an automation starts an app version that does; the message names them (`Tool '…' is used by the latest version of: …`). A deploy creates the tool again if your project still has its file. Fails with `Not found` when there is no such tool, and `Namespace '…' was not found.` when the namespace doesn't exist.

### ExtOpGet

Returns a tool's definition, with every version.

```c
jsonObject ExtOpGet(string name)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The tool: `name`, or `name@namespace`. |

**Returns** `jsonObject`: The tool, as a JSON object.

Name the tool as `name`, or `name@namespace` for one in another namespace of your tenant; a name without `@` is looked up in this app's namespace.

The JSON object starts with `$type` (`openapi` or `mcp`, after its connector), then holds `id`, `name`, `namespaceId` and `versions`. An `openapi` version has `connectorId` and `connectorVersion`, the connector it calls; `promptGuidance`, when the model should use it; `requiresApproval`; its fixed values, in `pathBindings`, `queryBindings` and `requestBindings`; and `authenticationHeader`, the header it sends and the id of the secret that fills it, never the secret's value.

Fails with `Not found` when there is no such tool, and `Namespace '…' was not found.` when the namespace doesn't exist.

### ExtOpInvoke

Calls a tool from the app, as an agent would, and returns the response.

```c
string ExtOpInvoke(string name, jsonObject request, jsonObject queryParams, jsonObject pathParams, guid secretId)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The tool: `name`, or `name@namespace`. |
| `request` | `jsonObject`, can be empty | The request body, as a JSON object: the fields the model would fill in. Pass `""` for none. |
| `queryParams` | `jsonObject`, can be empty | Query-string values, as a JSON object of names and values, such as `{ "limit": "10" }`. Pass `""` for none. |
| `pathParams` | `jsonObject`, can be empty | Values for the `{name}` placeholders in the connector's URL, as a JSON object, such as `{ "date": "2026-11-02" }`. Pass `""` for none. |
| `secretId` | `guid`, can be empty | The id of one of your secrets to send in place of the tool's own, in the same header. Only for a connector that authenticates with a header, and a tool that sends one. Pass `""` to use the tool's own. |

**Returns** `string`: The response body, as text: usually JSON.

Tools are known as external operations (extops) in Maitento, hence the call's name. Name the tool as `name`, or `name@namespace` for one in another namespace of your tenant; a name without `@` is looked up in this app's namespace. Only tools on HTTP (OpenAPI) connectors can be called this way, not MCP tools. The call uses the version of the tool this app pins (`functions.openApi` in the app's `.mtr` file), or else its latest enabled version.

Maitento adds what the tool fixes: its fixed values and its credential, from its secret. The request body is checked against the connector's request schema before the call is made. A tool whose connector authenticates as Maitento can't be called from an app.

It waits for the response: the remote has 100 seconds to start answering and 120 to finish. The response comes back as text, up to 256 KB; a longer one is cut short, with a note in front saying so. When the connector has a response schema the response must match it, and a response that isn't a JSON object comes back wrapped as `{ "result": … }`. Read it with [`StringToJsonObject`](conversion.md#stringtojsonobject).

Fails with `External operation execution failed: …` when the call fails: the remote answers with an error status (`Remote API returned status code: NotFound with response: …`), doesn't answer in time, or is at an address Maitento won't call, or the request doesn't match the schema. A tool that needs a person's approval is refused without being called (`External operation '…' needs a person's approval before it runs`): approvals happen in interactions. Also fails when the tool or its connector isn't found, or isn't an HTTP one.

### ExtOpList

Returns the tools in a namespace.

```c
jsonArray ExtOpList(string namespaceName)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `namespaceName` | `string`, can be empty | The namespace to list. Pass `""` for this app's own namespace. |

**Returns** `jsonArray`: A JSON array of tools.

Each element of the JSON array is a tool as [`ExtOpGet`](#extopget) returns it. Fails with `Namespace '…' was not found.` when the namespace doesn't exist.
